Actual L2 pullback implies product L1 under probability; derive ν-a.e. clock-section integrability and outer L1. Every measurable-set indicator-weighted pullback is product integrable by domination before signed Fubini.
Pair Q[G] with actual L2 indicators, use adjoint pairing and signed Fubini, then L1 set-integral uniqueness. Only after this a.e. equality infer expectation MemLp and equality of L2 classes.

Actual expectation depends only on the input real L2 equivalence class; equal input classes give equal output classes and hence nu-a.e. equal expectations. Mechanisms are the explicit OR alternatives below.
